cards.text:
D-PS01/001EN
Divine Knight of Triumph, Eulogias
G Unit｜ Royal Paladin｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand, and discard them] [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & turn a card from your G zone face up], draw the same number of cards as the number of your rear-guards, choose the same number of cards from your hand as the number of cards drawn, and call them to (RC). Then, if you have five or more rear-guards, you get an Imaginary Gift:Force.

D-PS01/002EN
Happiness Gathering Dragon King
G Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand, and discard them] [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Turn a card from your G zone face up], reveal cards from the top of your deck equal to the number of face up cards in your G zone +2, call all of the revealed normal units to (RC), put all of the revealed trigger units into your hand, and shuffle your deck. Then, activate all of the trigger effects of the revealed cards.

D-PS01/003EN
Holy Seraph, Zafkiel
G Unit｜ Angel Feather｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand, and discard them] [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Discard a card from your hand], choose up to three cards in total from your drop and circles other than (VC), and put them into your damage zone face up. All of your front row units get [Power] +10000 until end of turn for each normal unit put. This unit gets drive+1 until end of turn for each trigger unit put. For each card put, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it.

D-PS01/004EN
Dark Knight, Crow Cruach
G Unit｜ Shadow Paladin｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand, and discard them] [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Retire two rear-guards], your opponent chooses three of their rear-guards, and retires them. If they did not retire three cards, until end of turn, this unit gets "[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:At the end of the battle this unit attacked, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & retire two rear-guards], and [Stand] this unit.", and [Power] +10000.

D-PS01/005EN
Golden Knight of Prosperity, Idvarious
G Unit｜ Gold Paladin｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand, and discard them] [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[CONT](VC):All of your rear-guards placed by a card ability this turn get [Power] +5000.
[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], put all of your [Rest] rear-guards on the bottom of your deck in any order, choose up to two cards from your hand, and call them to (RC). If you put four or more cards into your deck, at the end of that battle, [Stand] this unit, and it gets drive-2 until end of turn.

D-PS01/006EN
Soul-offering Heavenly Dragon, Jagdanarruga
G Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 4｜ Power 15000｜ Shield
[Stride]-Stride Step-[COST][Choose one or more cards with the sum of their grades being 3 or greater from your hand, and discard them] [Stride] this card on your (VC) from face down.
[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:When this unit attacks, [COST][turn a card from your G zone face up], choose any number of cards with different grades from your drop, put them into your soul, and this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](VC):When your opponent's unit is put on (GC) other than from their deck, [COST][Soul-Blast 3], retire that unit, your opponent looks at the top card of their deck, and calls it to (GC).

D-PS01/007EN
Divine Dragon Knight, Barakat

If your opponent has five or more open (RC), all of your rear-guards get [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

D-PS01/008EN
Rikudo Stealth Rogue, Yatsukalord

[ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1] &[Soul-Blast 1], choose three unit cards from your opponent's drop, your opponent chooses any number of cards from among them, and calls them to (RC). Your opponent's cards' [AUTO] abilities do not activate from this call. For each unit that was called, your opponent chooses a card from their hand, and discards it. For each card you chose that was not called, you draw a card, and all of your front row units get [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], search your deck for up to two grade 2 or less cards, call them to open (RC), and shuffle your deck. Then, all of your rear-guards get "Boost" until end of turn.

[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), if your deck has thirteen or less cards, choose up to three [Critical] triggers from your soul, and return them to your deck and shuffle it.
